                        improved = True
                        break

                if improved:
                    break
            if improved:
                break

        if improved:
            nroutes = []
            ncost = []
            nload = []
            for i in range(len(routes)):
                if routes[i]:
                    nroutes.append(routes[i])
                    ncost.append(r_cost[i])
                    nload.append(r_load[i])
            routes, r_cost, r_load = nroutes, ncost, nload

    # --- EDIT 1 kept: Intra-route deterministic 2-opt ---
    def two_opt_improve(route):
        n = len(route)
        if n < 4:
            return route, False
        best_delta = 0
        best_i = -1
        best_j = -1

        for i in range(n - 1):
            a = depot if i == 0 else route[i - 1]
            b = route[i]
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                c = route[j]
                d = depot if j == n - 1 else route[j + 1]
                old = dist(a, b) + dist(c, d)
                new = dist(a, c) + dist(b, d)
                delta = new - old
                if delta < best_delta:
                    best_delta = delta
                    best_i = i
                    best_j = j

        if best_i != -1:
            route = route[:best_i] + route[best_i : best_j + 1][::-1] + route[best_j + 1 :]
            return route, True
        return route, False

    passes = 2
    while passes > 0:
        passes -= 1
        anychg = False
        for k in range(len(routes)):
            newr, ch = two_opt_improve(routes[k])
            if ch:
                routes[k] = newr
                r_cost[k] = route_cost(routes[k])
                anychg = True
        if not anychg:
            break

    return routes
